units.source_text: 忽然紫夫人对明石皇后说：“请你回那边歇息吧。

en.t: Suddenly Lady Murasaki said to Empress Akashi, "Please go back over there and rest.

units.source_text: 我此刻非常难过，想躺下了。

en.t: I feel terribly unwell just now, and I want to lie down.

units.source_text: 虽然身患重病，也不可过分失礼。”

en.t: Even though I am gravely ill, I must not be too discourteous."

units.source_text: 便把帷屏拉拢，躺下身子，那样子显得比平常痛苦得多。

en.t: Then she drew the curtains closed and lay down, looking far more distressed than usual.

units.source_text: 明石皇后见了，心念今天为何如此厉害，不胜惊异。

en.t: Seeing this, Empress Akashi wondered why her suffering was so severe today and was deeply astonished.

units.source_text: 便握住了她的手，一边望着她一边啜泣着。

en.t: She took Lady Murasaki's hand and sobbed softly while gazing at her.

units.source_text: 这真像刚才所咏萩上露的消散，已经到了弥留状态了。

en.t: It was truly like the vanishing dew on the bush clover they had just sung of; she had already reached her final moments.

units.source_text: 于是邸内惊慌骚扰起来，

en.t: At once the whole residence fell into panic and commotion,

units.source_text: 立刻派遣无数人员，前往各处命僧人诵经祈祷。

en.t: and countless messengers were immediately sent everywhere to have monks chant sutras and offer prayers.

units.source_text: 她以前曾有好几次昏厥过去，后来又苏醒转来。

en.t: Several times before she had fainted and then later come back to herself.

units.source_text: 源氏看惯了，疑心此次也是鬼怪一时作祟，便举行种种退鬼之法。

en.t: Genji, used to such episodes, suspected that this too was a passing affliction by a spirit, and had various rites performed to drive it away.

units.source_text: 但闹了一夜，终于不见效验，天明时分，紫夫人竟长逝了。

en.t: But after a night of turmoil, nothing proved effective, and at daybreak Lady Murasaki finally passed away.

units.source_text: 明石皇后不曾回宫，得亲自送终，一则以喜，一则以悲。

en.t: Empress Akashi had not returned to the palace, so she was able to attend her final moments in person, a cause for both gratitude and grief.

units.source_text: 院内所有的人，都不肯相信这死别是世间应有之常例，

en.t: Everyone in the residence refused to believe that this parting by death was an ordinary rule of the world,

units.source_text: 大家认为她不应该死，

en.t: and all felt that she should not have died,

units.source_text: 悲恸之极，似觉身在黎明乱梦之中。

en.t: so overcome with grief that they seemed to be caught in a disordered dream at dawn.

units.source_text: 这原是当然之事。

en.t: This was only natural.

units.source_text: 此时院内已经没有一个人能够办事。

en.t: By then there was no one in the residence capable of attending to any affairs.

units.source_text: 所有的侍女都哭得死去活来。

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting wept as if their hearts would break.

units.source_text: 源氏主君尤为悲恸，无法自制。

en.t: Lord Genji was especially grief-stricken and could not control himself.
